summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and spot prices edged lower today. DCE most-traded closed at 640.5 yuan/mt, down 1.16% from the previous close.All eight Qingdao spot products declined by 4-11 yuan/wmt, seaborne 61% and 65% indices fell to USD 88.15 and 103.60/dmt, and all 12 brands moved lower. Prices indicate near-term quotation pressure, but synchronized declines do not establish any one event as the sole driver.
